label_method: per-point least-squares slope over the readings in the window, fitted with a separate intercept for every uninterrupted stretch of readings (a new stretch starts after a gap of 30+ days, where DWR's cumulative series restarts at 0), times the window length; a point is usable with at least 20 readings and stretches that together cover at least 60% of the window; cell label = median over the usable points inside the cell; positive = sinking
